verdict.rationale: All MCP-related evidence describes Vercel *publishing* its own official MCP server (mcp.vercel.com) for external AI clients to connect to and use Vercel's tools — the reverse of this story, which asks whether Vercel itself can consume external MCP servers as tools. No evidence shows Vercel Agent, eve, or any other Vercel feature accepting/plugging in third-party MCP servers to extend its own capabilities.
